description: Read one member register entry and assignment history by exact member ID. Assignment dates preserve source precision and do not establish historical sitting status.

assignmentOffset.description: Assignment offset in published source order.

memberId.description: Numeric memberId from riksdag_search_members, including leading zeros.

revision.description: Revision returned by the preceding assignment page.

name: riksdag_get_member

from.description: Source start date or timestamp, without inferred timezone.

to.description: Source end date or timestamp; not proof of current service.

detailAvailable.description: Whether a numeric member IID is published for riksdag_get_member.

effectiveQuery.description: Normalized input, defaults and local filters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_filter`: A memberId that passes the input pattern is not a valid ID after normalization. `revision_changed`: Revision no longer matches. `upstream_identity_mismatch`: Source rows contradict the required identity. `upstream_schema_invalid`: Payload violates the wire contract. `upstream_unavailable`: Source unavailable after retries. `upstream_queue_full`: Upstream queue is full. `candidate_limit_reached`: Complete-list safety limit reached. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Whether the exact member IID exists.

guidance.description: Next step when the member IID is absent.

memberId.description: Numeric register IID, including leading zeros; absent for some historical and European Parliament entries.

name.description: Published given and family names, when present.

args.description: Complete normalized arguments for riksdag_get_member, valid against its input schema; pass back unchanged.

items.description: A limitation, applied bound or next-step notice.

retrievedAt.description: Source fetch time; unchanged on cache hits.

serviceClassification.description: Source-defined Swedish chamber service; unknown is retained.

source.description: Required attribution to the Swedish Parliament.

sourceRecordId.description: Source register UUID, distinct from the member IID.

truncated.description: Whether further assignments remain via nextCall.

upstreamQuery.description: Upstream query echo, not proof a filter applied.
